description: The bar chart compares the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and another system (represented by the darker blue bars), across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60, with a scale increment of 10. The horizontal axis displays the four categories. For the Simple category, NatSQL achieved an accuracy of 60.21, while the other system achieved 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL scored 39.64, and the other system scored 48.60. For the Challenging category, NatSQL achieved 32.32, and the other system achieved 36.11. In the Total category, NatSQL achieved 51.35, and the other system achieved 56.19. The chart visually indicates that the other system consistently outperforms NatSQL across all four categories.
